gloss: by itself; automatically; of its own accord

definitions.gloss: by itself; on its own; without anyone doing anything
definitions.explanation: Describes something that happens with no one causing it. Typically used of doors, machines, and physical conditions that change without human intervention — often with a hint of surprise or unease.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ひとりでに⟦{治|なお}る→治る：19598_naoru⟧でしょう。
examples.english: The wound will probably heal on its own.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{触|さわ}っていない→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひとりでに⟦{動|うご}き{出|だ}した→動き出す：18597_ugokidasu⟧。
examples.english: Even though no one touched it, the machine started up by itself.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧ (alone) + で + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, but written in kana. Points at the absence of an agent: nobody did it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ひとりでに⟦{開|あ}く→開く：00689_aku⟧: to open by itself
- ひとりでに⟦{治|なお}る→治る：19598_naoru⟧: to heal on its own
- ひとりでに⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: to stop of its own accord

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おのずと→おのずと：06714_onozuto⟧: naturally, in due course — stresses a natural process leading to an outcome, not the absence of an agent
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: naturally — everyday word for outcomes that come about without effort, including feelings
- ⟦{自動的|じどうてき}→自動的：25589_jidouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: automatically — about a mechanism designed to do it, so no surprise is implied
